items.item: The form is split into titled sections (personal, job and contract, bank and tax, emergency contact, documents) in a single column, with a visible label above every field and no placeholder-only labels
items.evidence: Five titled sections (h2 '1. Thông tin cá nhân' ... '5. Giấy tờ') with labels above each input and no placeholders. But fields are laid out in a multi-column grid ('grid sm:grid-cols-6', col-span-2/3 side by side, 3 fields per row in screenshot), not a single column.

items.item: Required fields are marked consistently, and optional fields are labelled as optional or left unmarked by a stated convention
items.evidence: Required fields use '.req::after' red asterisk consistently, optional fields are unmarked, but no legend or note states the convention. Only the documents list says '(không bắt buộc)' for the one optional doc, so the convention is mixed.

items.item: Field widths match their content: dates, postal codes and tax codes are narrow; inputs use the right types (email, tel, date)
items.evidence: Dates (dob, cccdDate, startDate) and CCCD/MST/BHXH are 'sm:col-span-2' (one third width), type=date, type=tel (#phone), type=email (#email), type=number for dependents. No postal code field exists. Phone and email are half width, acceptable.

items.item: An option to save the form as a draft is offered, and saving a draft does not demand every required field
items.evidence: #btnDraft 'Lưu nháp' handler saves all field values to localStorage with no validation and shows 'Đã lưu nháp lúc ...'.

items.item: Save and Cancel stay reachable while scrolling (a sticky bar or equivalent), Save is a verb label and is not disabled before submitting
items.evidence: Bar 'fixed bottom-0 inset-x-0' with 'Hủy', 'Lưu nháp' and 'Hoàn tất tiếp nhận' (verb phrase); #btnSubmit has no disabled attribute.

items.item: Fields validate on blur and on submit; with several errors a summary at the top links to each field and focus moves to the first invalid field
items.evidence: focusout listener adds to 'touched' and update() toggles '.err' (blur validation); submit marks all touched and calls bad.focus() on first '.err'. But there is no error summary with links to fields; only a generic toast 'Vui lòng sửa các trường được đánh dấu đỏ.' and a footer count.

items.item: Leaving the page with unsaved input triggers a warning
items.evidence: No 'beforeunload' handler anywhere in the script. Only the Cancel button uses confirm().

items.item: The document upload states accepted file types and the size limit, lists chosen files with a remove button, and is keyboard operable
items.evidence: Section states 'PDF, JPG hoặc PNG, tối đa 5 MB mỗi tệp', lists file name and size, and has a 'Gỡ' remove button. But the file input is 'class="hidden fileIn"' (display:none) inside a label, so it cannot receive keyboard focus; the 'Tải lên' label is not focusable.

items.item: Success is confirmed with a message that names the employee and is announced to assistive technology
items.evidence: Submit calls toast('Đã tiếp nhận '+fullName+' (NV-2026-0148)...') which names the employee, but #toast is a plain div with no role=status/alert or aria-live, so it is not announced.

notes: Sidebar is bg-slate-900 with a blue brand accent (mild navy-sidebar tell). Emergency contacts render as bordered boxes inside the section card (card-in-card). Doc status badges use green/amber/grey pills (mild, not full rainbow-status). Audit score 80: 12 text-contrast failures (slate-500 on white 4.34:1, section-nav dots) and a small target on #sameAddr. Form is prefilled with mock data (93% complete) and the only contact is a prefilled sample. Cancel uses confirm() and clears everything. Single-column and error-summary, beforeunload, keyboard upload and aria-live are the main gaps.
